# KS-965 - Wednesday's task for Ornith (written 07:07 on 2026-09-23 from the file at develop 2bc5ccf63 - `USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md`, 219 lines read whole)

File: `USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md`
Tip: 2bc5ccf63b8c40911afb568b03cace066238ffcf

## Scope - this task is DELIBERATELY NARROWER than its ticket (read this first)
KS-965 is **87 documentary occurrences of the retired admin credential across 55 files**, measured 2026-09-07.
Re-measured at this tip: **86 occurrences across 54 files** (`.md`/`.mdc`/`.txt`, tracked, whole repo).
**This task changes ONE file - `USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md` - and closes 2 of those 86 occurrences
(its lines 68 and 177), leaving 84 occurrences across 53 files. The work REFS KS-965 and DOES NOT CLOSE IT;
the ticket stays open and the remaining 53 files are other rounds.**
This file is the cut because it is the canonical credential table the other files paraphrase, and because it
**already carries the replacement wording for a sibling account** at `:81` (the table cell) and `:181` (the smoke
loop) - so both edits are a copy of an in-file pattern, not an invention.

## What is wrong (one paragraph)
KS-966 retired the published `SYSTEM_ADMIN` default: at this tip `Blockchain/Dev/services/auth/src/repositories/userRepo.ts:1269`
defines `requiredSeedPw = (envVar) => process.env[envVar] || null`, and `:1300`-`:1308` bind the `admin@secuura.com`
row to `requiredSeedPw('ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD')` with `passwordVar: 'ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD'` and **no fallback** - so an
unset variable leaves that account unseeded rather than reachable by a published password. This file still tells a
reader to log in as that account with a literal password: **line 68** (the `## 2. Default-tenant accounts` table row)
and **line 177** (the `## 7. Quick smoke (terminal)` login loop). Both are wrong rather than dangerous - the value no
longer authenticates - and both are fixed the way `:81` and `:181` already fix the sibling `platform.admin@...` row:
**name the environment variable and say there is no default.** Nothing else in this file changes. In particular
**line 3** (the "Stale as of 2026-09-07" preamble note), **line 73** (the Use-case sentence naming `admin@secuura.com`),
**line 202** (the "16 x `200` by default" expectation) and every other account's row and loop entry stay exactly as they
are - line 202 is a counted claim this task has not re-measured and must not be rewritten from a guess.

## The exact change - 2 SMALL EDITS, 2 hunks in `USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md` (2 `-` lines, 2 `+` lines, one `+` per hunk)
Copy the block below BYTE FOR BYTE as your whole diff: the two file-header lines, each `@@` header, every context line
(a leading space, copied from `files[product_file]` - several end in a backslash, copy it), every `-` line and every
`+` line, in this order. Do not add, drop, re-wrap or reword a line; never write a literal `\n` inside a line.
Both `+` lines are ASCII.
```
--- a/USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md
+++ b/USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md
@@ -65,7 +65,7 @@
 | Email | Password | Role | Verification | Tenant | UUID |
 |---|---|---|---|---|---|
 | `demo@secuura.io` | `demo123` | `ISSUER_ADMIN` (was `OWNER` until KS-547) | `ENHANCED` | `default` | `a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010` |
-| `admin@secuura.com` | `admin123` | `SYSTEM_ADMIN` | `HIGH` | `default` | `b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001` |
+| `admin@secuura.com` | `ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD` (no default - account not seeded if unset) | `SYSTEM_ADMIN` | `HIGH` | `default` | `b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001` |
 | `issuer@secuura.com` | `issuer123` | `ISSUER_ADMIN` | `ENHANCED` | `default` | `a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000030` |
 | `verifier@secuura.com` | `verifier123` | `VERIFIER` | `STANDARD` | `default` | `a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000040` |
 | `holder@secuura.com` | `holder123` | `OWNER` | `BASIC` | `default` | `a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000050` |
@@ -175,6 +175,6 @@
 for u in \
   demo@secuura.io:demo123 \
-  admin@secuura.com:admin123 \
+  admin@secuura.com:${ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD} \
   issuer@secuura.com:issuer123 \
   verifier@secuura.com:verifier123 \
   holder@secuura.com:holder123 \
```

## Where (every **must change** line must appear as a `-` line in your diff, at its number)
The two must-change lines are quoted ONCE ONLY, in the fenced block above, and are NOT repeated here: each one
publishes the retired credential, and Wednesday reproduces it exactly as many times as the checker needs and no
more. Take their bytes from the fence, or from `files[product_file]` at these line numbers - never from memory.
* `:68` - **must change**: the `admin@secuura.com` row of the `## 2.` table; its 2nd cell is the retired literal in backticks. Replace the whole line with the `+` line of hunk 1.
* `:177` - **must change**: the `admin@secuura.com` entry of the `## 7.` login loop; `<email>:<literal>` plus a trailing ` \`. Replace the whole line with the `+` line of hunk 2.
* `:67`, `:69`, `:70`, `:71` - (correct) the `demo@`, `issuer@`, `verifier@` and `holder@` rows - stay, byte for byte.
* `:81` - (correct) the `platform.admin@secuura-test.invalid` row - **stays**, and is the wording hunk 1 copies.
* `:176`, `:178`, `:179`, `:180` - (correct) the other loop entries - stay, trailing backslashes included.
* `:181` - (correct) `  platform.admin@secuura-test.invalid:${DEMO_SECUURA_PASSWORD} \` - **stays**, and is the shape hunk 2 copies.
* `:3`, `:73`, `:202` - (correct) **stay** - see the paragraph above; `:202` is an unre-measured count.

## Required (the checker's proof - each token ABSENT in the section at the tip, PRESENT after)
- `## 2. Default-tenant accounts` :: ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD
- `## 7. Quick smoke` :: ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD

## Output
Exactly ONE ```diff block, ONE file section `--- a/USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md` / `+++ b/USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md`, 2 hunks with the headers and counts exactly as in `## The exact change`. No prose before or after the block.

## Premises (measured at develop 2bc5ccf63b8c40911afb568b03cace066238ffcf by Wednesday's KS-965 drafter, 2026-09-23 07:07 AEST, read-only `git show` / `git grep` against the Secuura source checkout - no write verb was run there)
- Tip read by `git -C <secuura checkout> ls-remote origin refs/heads/develop` -> `2bc5ccf63b8c40911afb568b03cace066238ffcf`; the object is local (`cat-file -t` = commit), so no `tip_override` was used.
- `USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md` at the tip is 219 lines / 13857 bytes; every context and `-` line above was taken from `git show 2bc5ccf63:USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md` programmatically, not retyped.
- The retired literal occurs in this file **exactly twice**, at `:68` and `:177` (`git grep -n` at the tip); repo-wide at the tip it occurs **86 times in 54 documentary files** (169 times in 117 files including executable ones).
- `ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD` occurs **0 times** in this file at the tip - so both Required tokens are genuinely absent before (D4 has something to prove).
- Section ranges on the tip file: `## 2. Default-tenant accounts (6)` = `:61`-`:76`; `## 7. Quick smoke (terminal)` = `:154`-`:211`. The edit at `:68` lies in the first, the edit at `:177` in the second - so every changed region lies inside a Required section (D6).
- The fix shape is the ticket's own: *"name the environment variable instead ... say the credential is not published and name what supplies it"* (KS-965), the same treatment KS-949 F2 gave `:81` and `:181` of this very file.
- KS-965's "do after, not before" precondition is **met for this file**: KS-966 items 1 and 2 are DONE at this tip (PR #888 - `requiredSeedPw` with no fallback at `userRepo.ts:1269`, `ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD` bound at `:1305`, the `KS-966 F2` comment at `:1407`). Items 3 and 4 are still open, but they touch scripts/harnesses, not what a credential table should say.
- Ticket state read from the Secuura Linear board at 07:0x AEST 2026-09-23: KS-965 Backlog, Low, unassigned, not archived, no attachments, no open PR. `night/done.md` carries **0** rows for KS-965.
- No hunk overlaps a held READY: `USER_TESTING/CREDENTIALS-AND-PORTALS.md` is a root-level test-documentation file, not under `Blockchain/Dev/services/**`.

## UNMEASURED (reasoned, not run)
- **The golden precheck was NOT run.** This drafter was told not to run the model or the checker, so there is no
  `checker.sh` PASS for these hunks and no `git apply --check` in a clone. D2/D6/D7/D8 are predicted from the tip
  bytes, not observed. Whoever feeds this should expect a first-round verdict, not a confirmed one.
- **Line 202's "16 x `200` by default" is now arithmetically stale** and is deliberately left alone. With
  `ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD` unset as well as `DEMO_SECUURA_PASSWORD`, two accounts are unseeded rather than one, so the
  default count is very likely 15 - but that is inference from `userRepo.ts`, **not a login run**, and this task must
  not write an unmeasured number into a credentials document. It needs a real smoke run and its own round.
- **The 84 remaining occurrences are not triaged here.** Some of the 53 files are dated session transcripts under
  `Blockchain/Testing/USER SIMULATED TEST/runs/` and `USER_TESTING/TESTING-AGENT-FEEDBACK-RUN*.md`; KS-949 explicitly
  left open whether rewriting a record falsifies it. That ruling is still open and this task does not pre-empt it.
- **The repo-wide count was taken with one literal**, the one this file publishes at `:68`. If the KS-964/KS-966
  measurement counted a second spelling, the 86/54 here is a floor, not a ceiling.
- **`admin@secuura.com`'s UUID disagrees between this file (`b0000000-...-0001`, `:68`) and the seeder
  (`a0000000-...-020`, `userRepo.ts:1300`).** Noticed, not fixed, not in scope - flagged so the next round can rule on it.

## 5. Login mechanics

All accounts authenticate at the same endpoint regardless of role:

```bash
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "<email>",
  "password": "<password>",
  "clientType": "browser"   // optional; "native" returns refresh token in body too
}
```

- Browser portals set the refresh token via `httpOnly` cookie (pen-test F-10).
- Mobile / native clients must send `clientType: 'native'` to receive the refresh token in the response body.
- Failed login attempts: 5 within 15 min from the same `(email, source-ip-/24)` pair → 15-min lockout (pen-test F-06). Lockouts return the same generic `Invalid email or password` shape — no enumeration.
- The audit log middleware (BACKLOG H1) records every `auth.login` (success + 401) with IP + duration + actor (when available).

---

## 6. Tenant context for SYSTEM_ADMIN

When `admin@secuura.com` or `platform.admin@secuura-test.invalid` log in, the admin sidebar shows a **tenant switcher** dropdown. Selecting a tenant adds an `X-Tenant-Override` header to all API calls so the admin sees that tenant's data.

A persistent **orange "Cross-tenant mode" banner** (BACKLOG H12) appears at the top of every page while a tenant is selected, with a "Clear" button to leave cross-tenant mode. This prevents destructive actions in the wrong tenant.

- (There is no separate Azure Dev env on the new tenant — single demo env only.)

If any account returns `401`:

## 8. Notes on environment quirks

- **Postgres roles:** services connect as `secuura_app` (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS — T2-E Phase 2). Migrations still use `secuura` superuser for DDL. This is enforced by RLS on 9 tenant-scoped tables but Phase-1 permissive policies preserve current behaviour for queries that don't set the GUC.
- **CSRF:** state-changing requests need an `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header matching the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie. Browser portals handle this automatically via axios interceptors; curl / Postman need to fetch the cookie first (e.g. `curl -c jar.txt /api/health`).
- **Audit log:** every authed POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE is recorded in the `audit_logs` table (gateway middleware, BACKLOG H1). Visible in admin → Platform Audit Log, merged with the older `platform_audit_log` source.
- **Cardano network:** Local dev uses Yaci DevKit (Preview testnet substitute). The **new live demo env runs `SIMULATE_ANCHORING=true`** — anchoring is simulated (no live Blockfrost), so use it for functional demos, not as on-chain proof. Verification is still chain-first via `POST /api/verification/verify { contentHash }` (`services/originate/src/routes/verification.ts`).
- **PII encryption:** `auth`/`kyc`/`security`/`originate`/`tokenisation` require `PII_ENCRYPTION_KEY` and `PII_LOOKUP_HMAC_KEY` env vars at startup (commit `d6e287d1c` onwards). Stored in each environment's Key Vault (`pii-encryption-key` / `pii-lookup-hmac-key`); generated by `./deployment/azure/sync-secrets.sh`. Without these, `auth.users` rows can't be read and login returns 401 with internal error `PII_LOOKUP_HMAC_KEY is not registered`.
- **Outlook add-in (M365):** on the **NEW live demo env** at `https://secuura02-demo-outlook.kindtree-935b2ded.southeastasia.azurecontainerapps.io/`. Manifest `<AppDomain>` still hardcodes `localhost:6104` so it won't pass real Office 365 install validation; smoke-test against the served URL only.
